legal_basis.to: City Council Motion No. M-26-63 (adopted 2026-01-28; interim zoning district + permitting hold, implemented via Zoning Docket 037/26); companion Motion No. M-26-62 (adopted the same day; directs the City Planning Commission to study and recommend permanent Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance text amendments defining and regulating data centers, implemented via Zoning Docket 036/26). Both motions were introduced by Councilmembers Morrell and Hughes (by request).

current_status.from: Active interim permitting hold and proposed Data Center Interim Zoning District under City Planning Commission review as of 2026-04-29 [VERIFY: 2026-04-28 CPC action outcome on ZD 037/26 not yet retrieved from CPC minutes as of 2026-04-29].
current_status.to: Active. The City Planning Commission approved Zoning Docket 037/26 (the Data Center Interim Zoning District text amendment implementing M-26-63) by a 7-0 vote at its April 28, 2026 meeting, following the staff recommendation of approval; the companion Zoning Docket 036/26 (permanent CZO text amendment implementing M-26-62) was deferred at the same meeting. The interim permitting hold under M-26-63 has been in effect since City Council adoption on 2026-01-28 and continues while the CPC's recommendation on ZD 037/26 awaits final City Council action; no evidence of final Council adoption of either text amendment was found as of the 2026-07-31 research date.
current_status.reason: The City of New Orleans' own Granicus meeting portal for the City Planning Commission (cityofno.granicus.com) shows the April 28, 2026 agenda and vote summary for Zoning Docket 037/26 recording 'ACTION: APPROVE, VOTE: 7-0,' and the official CPC staff report (dated April 21, 2026, prepared by staff planner Ava Monnet, signed off by Executive Director Robert D. Rivers) recommends approval and describes the docket as a companion to Docket 036/26. This directly answers the marker's question about the April 28 CPC outcome.

verify_resolutions.note: Found and read the full signed text of Motion No. M-26-62 via the City of New Orleans Granicus document system (linked from Appendix A of the official CPC staff report for ZD 037/26). Motion M-26-62, introduced by Councilmembers Morrell and Hughes (by request) and adopted January 28, 2026, directs the City Planning Commission to hold a public hearing on amendments to the CZO (Ordinance No. 4264 M.C.S.) 'to define Data Centers and any related uses, to consider whether these uses should be permitted or conditional in any zoning district or overlay, and to implement appropriate use and design standards... including but not limited to density requirements, soundproofing and safety measures.' This matches, and now directly sources, the language already summarized in the record's outcome field.
